name: TBETS (complete turn)
description: MCTS over turn genomes (one flat gene sequence per player turn; heterogeneous-mcts's atomic actions as genes): root = current state, its children my remaining turn, every node's children the next player's turn. Expansion at the UCB1-selected leaf: EMCTS_GREEDY_PCT % a child (the next turn's greedy genome), otherwise a mutated sibling; greedy rollouts of EMCTS_ROLLOUT rounds. Searched at all three phases.
